summary: Corrective fix for a r0068 Remote DJ regression: _remote_dj_add_element() treated Gst.Bin.add()'s Python return value as the success signal, but on the production Ubuntu/PyGObject/GStreamer runtime that call returns None even when the element was actually added and parented, causing every Remote DJ connection to fail with a false 'could not add to the main pipeline' error. Now verified by the element's actual parent instead.
